references.text: Completes the genealogy: 36:25 introduces Oholibama as the daughter of Anah, while 36:14 details her children and confirms her role in Edom's history.
Clarifies the identity of 'the daughter of Anah' by specifying that Anah is the son of Zibeon and confirming Oholibama's role as Esau's wife.
Confirms and expands on the status of Oholibama as the daughter of Anah by listing her sons as chiefs in Edom.
Places Anah in his proper genealogical context as a son of Seir, which explains his position before he had children Dishon and Oholibama.
Resolves the genealogical ambiguity by presenting Anah as the son of Zibeon (along with Aiah), completing the picture of Anah's origin.
